rv.q: The history-based 'White Rose: The Musical' has its heart in the right place.
Brian Belding's book and lyrics repeatedly take us out of 1942.
'White Rose: The Musical' is a serious misfire, its tensionless book, mediocre performances...and generic score often teetering precariously on the borderline of amateurishness.
White Rose is…worth seeing...its salience… and its theatrical significance are undeniable.
